name: s15_tie_n_way
purpose: Three- and four-way Speed ties in eachEvent with two holders: four Pokemon of Speed 105 (Rillaboom, Ceruledge, Archaludon, Gholdengo with one Speed point) are on the field, Rillaboom's Grassy Surge triggers the two Grassy Seeds in a four-way TerrainChange tie, and every Update ties the four with two Sitrus Berry holders; when Gholdengo faints the Update ties are three-way, and a slower replacement keeps them so.
